About Me

Who is Fenrok?

I got into editing because I genuinely love making content feel incredible. Three years later I have worked with creators across gaming, documentary, anime, podcast, reaction and educational content, from brand new channels to ones with millions of subscribers.

Every editor can cut a video. What I care about is whether it holds attention, whether it fits the creator's voice, and whether it arrives on time. That is what keeps clients coming back.

I have been the main editor on B.D.A. Law for over two years, which means I know what it takes to hold a schedule, not just deliver one good video.
